limitations: Source properties only. No new benchmark, training or runtime verification.
The inspected working copy includes uncommitted controller and collision changes. Historical July scores do not measure this snapshot.

Information used describes policy behavior, not enforced observation permissions. Each autonomous controller receives the ordinary observation; Course Cartographer additionally reconstructs the course from its seed.
The ordinary observation encodes up to three upcoming hazards, not strictly on-screen hazards. Distance is clamped during encoding.
Line references identify inspected working-copy files, not the base commit. Hashes identify source bytes; this extract does not include those source files.
